decisions.action: Retain existing learner species Paspalum distichum at species rank; 1759 Linnaean name. No rename or new card.

decisions.source_name: Digitaria disticha (L.) Fiori & Paol.; Milium distichum (L.) Muhl.
decisions.action: These same-type combinations map to existing knotgrass concept; retain as historical aliases only.

decisions.source_name: Digitaria paspalodes Michx.; Paspalum paspalodes (Michx.) Scribn.; Anastrophus paspalodes (Michx.) Nash
decisions.action: POWO places these names under P. distichum; do not create separate cards from them.

decisions.source_name: Paspalum distichum subsp. paspalodes (Michx.) Thell.; P. distichum var. paspalodes (Michx.) Thell.
decisions.action: Both historical ranks synonymized into species P. distichum under POWO; do not infer subspecies from photos.
POWO treats P. vaginatum as independently accepted; do NOT collapse seashore paspalum into P. distichum or treat it as a simple synonym under current POWO. No uninstalled card is created.

decisions.source_name: Paspalum distichum subsp. vaginatum (Sw.) P.Fourn.; P. distichum var. vaginatum (Sw.) Griseb.; P. distichum var. littorale (R.Br.) F.M.Bailey; P. distichum var. anpinense Hayata
decisions.action: Despite distichum epithet in old combinations, POWO maps these to separately accepted P. vaginatum, not the learner knotgrass species.
Historical P. vaginatum var. pubescens is assigned by POWO to P. distichum. Exact author/rank must be retained to avoid misleading epithet-based mapping.

decisions.source_name: USFS FEIS 1992 Paspalum distichum broad concept including P. vaginatum
decisions.accepted_name: Paspalum distichum L. and Paspalum vaginatum Sw. (separate POWO accepted species)
decisions.action: USFS 1992 explicitly lumps P. vaginatum into knotgrass for its ecological account; this differs from current POWO species split. Do not use broad FEIS synonym list to overwrite current taxon mapping or claim all cited historical observations are P. distichum sensu stricto.

decisions.source_name: Paspalum distichum learner specimen, photos and purported hybrids
decisions.action: Accepted names and historic aliases do not validate any learner photo, mature spikelet measurement, or individual hybrid. Retain existing visual, identity, hybrid and range statuses; no reidentification, photo sourcing or county audit.

conflict_and_hold_summary.paspalum_vaginatum: PASS separate accepted species under POWO/WCVP
conflict_and_hold_summary.historical_feis_lumping: UNRESOLVED authority concept conflict; do not merge

handoff: No canonical rename, photo ID assignment or installation. Maintain POWO split in future historical-record reconciliation; specimen ID held.
